routes.next: the animals bound is now PROVED; the next rung is the linked-cluster expansion's cluster-weight sum, chaining the animals bound to the block-spin contraction ρ ≤ e^(−A·e^(−cβ))
rungs: Connected.exists_isTree_le (Mathlib): a connected graph has a spanning tree T ≤ G (IsTree T)
IsTree.existsUnique_path (Mathlib): a tree has a unique path between any two vertices
EULER TOUR (NOT in Mathlib): a tree on n vertices has a walk of length 2(n−1) visiting all n vertices (each edge traversed twice)
injection connected-subset → Euler-tour walk, then walk_count_bound gives #{clusters of size n} ≤ Δ^(2(n−1))
proved: connected_exists_visiting_walk — a connected graph has a walk visiting every vertex (the Euler tour's existence, kernel-checked)
tree_euler_tour_length — a tree has a closed walk visiting every vertex with length ≤ 2(n−1) (kernel-checked)
connected_subset_tour — a connected induced subset S has a closed walk visiting all of S with length ≤ 2(|S|−1)
rooted_tree_tour — a tree has a closed walk from any prescribed root r visiting every vertex, length ≤ 2(n−1)
rooted_subset_tour — a rooted connected subset S has a closed walk from r visiting all of S, length ≤ 2(|S|−1)
rooted_animals_count_bound — #{rooted connected clusters of size n} ≤ (2n)(Δ+1)^(2(n−1)) via the S↦tour injection + walk_count_bound
